name: use_meme
description: Send a meme. search finds candidates by scene, mood, tags or visual content; show sends one and renders it in the terminal (a GIF previews as a still frame). Search first unless the user gave an exact id.

query.description: search: scenario, mood, visual content or intent.

id.description: show: full sha256 id or a unique short id.

alone.description: show: the meme is the whole reply. Anything you write after this call is dropped, so use it when the meme already says it.
